acceptance: For one synthetic project, disable then reenable an optional known metric through local maintenance; the immutable configuration revision, Java collection plan, Python fake-transport output and Java input validation agree. Required/unknown/duplicate fields, missing rows keys/groups and changed selections fail without publishing success. Historical v1 sources and manual evidence retain their own contracts.
scope: Only the existing 28-metric catalog; 5 dashboard dependencies and 5 dimensions fixed. No arbitrary registry, formula changes, schema migration, cloud, second real account or automatic historical refill.

owners.core: metric_compatibility_review: configuration and validation Java plus related tests/fixtures
owners.integration: main: API/plan wiring, cross-process verification, contracts and memory

catalog.selection: Reject unknown, duplicate or missing required IDs; canonical order is the base catalog order. Keep all five groups, dimensions, page sizes, filters and sort; intersect each group's metrics with the selection.

configuration.field: enabledMetrics: canonical metric ID array, included in candidateHash and immutable revision
configuration.legacy: Read v1 as full 28 without rewriting its bytes. Old project-only preflight/apply preserves the current selection; never silently enables all metrics.
configuration.http: Existing project-configuration-v1 HTTP envelope adds enabledMetrics, metricCatalog[{id,label,required}], metricChangesEnabled:true. POST may include enabledMetrics; omitted means preserve current. Existing local guards and independent readback apply.
configuration.history: Selection affects subsequent plans, not historical rows. Reenable does not refill past data; never infer zero for a field not collected.

acquisitionContract.catalogSha256: SHA-256 of bundled base resource bytes
acquisitionContract.selectionSha256: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON canonical selected array

input.binding: Same acquisitionContract in both source files; validate supported schemas/catalog and catalog/selection hashes. The executor independently checks plan/configuration file hashes and derivation; input validator checks the embedded snapshot, not the active configuration or an online identity claim.
input.rows: Exact selected metrics plus fixed five dimensions; missing key is not equivalent to explicit null/UNKNOWN. V2 numeric metric values become exact decimal text without unit conversion or rounding; source strings/null/UNKNOWN remain unchanged. Material ID must already be a nonempty string. The upstream HTTP response bytes are separate immutable evidence; no existing input JSON is modified.
input.pagination: All five expected groups with original page sizes must close even for zero-row days.
input.zeroSpendMissingGroup: Observed live on authorized 2026-10-12: non-base groups can omit whole zero-spend material rows. Preserve the proven base-zero row, merge all observed values first, then mark only still-absent selected metrics UNKNOWN; receipt records material/group/reason/unknownFields under base-zero-spend-absent-group-unknown-v1. Never rewrite raw HTTP, substitute zero, permit positive-spend missing groups or forgive malformed returned rows.
input.legacy: Automatic v1 requires known historical catalog, exact 33 fields and five groups; no synthetic catalog bypass. MANUAL_HISTORY remains under its separate reader and mapping, including _manual_history.

execution.default: Offline; no credentials read, network, database, legacy writes or deletion
execution.real: Requires current user authorization, explicit single project/date plan, --execute and project-local private credential file; only the established read-only MCP report tool is callable
execution.outputs: Unique .local/collector-runs directory, immutable raw pages/publication/receipt; COLLECTED_NOT_IMPORTED never means database acceptance
execution.limits: One explicit numeric anchor; JSON MCP responses only. Current official capability and selected-field combinations require actual authorized validation.

stop: Do not mark items 1/2 fully complete without a real authorized new-day round trip; item 3 remains user business acceptance. Items 4/5 remain paused by D-044.
